items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 74:1
items.html: (To the question) It is the aspect of the VAK of AB, which Aba and Ima receive from the Mazalot and the hairs of the head, while they are still upon them as Makifim. (Item 108).
